capabilities: add a Poster Rows layout to any base
group notes into sideways-scrolling rows by property, rating, or modification date
display a cycling featured banner of top-rated notes
configure cover, title, rating, and banner-text properties
open, preview, or show details for notes from cards
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or newer. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin makes no network requests of its own; web cover URLs are fetched by Obsidian itself.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases layouts show notes as tables or lists, which does not suit media libraries where a visual cover grid is the natural way to browse.

relations.evidence: It was built for notes made by the Media DB plugin (movies, series, games, books, music)

summary: Bases view that displays notes as a featured banner and horizontally scrolling rows of cover-image cards, styled like a streaming-service home page.
